sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned AGA for the State and perused the records.

2. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants with the prayer to quash charge-sheet dated 10.02.2021 and cognizance and summoning order dated 27.07.2022 as well as entire proceedings of Case No.469 of 2022 (State Vs. Dharmendra Kumar and others),
arising out of case Crime No. 53 of 2020, under Sections 498A, 323, 504 and 506 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Rampur,

sentences.text: 1 3. Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that opposite party no.2 is the wife of applicant no.1 and applicant no.2 is her mother-in-law.

4. Learned counsel for the applicants has further submitted that on account of matrimonial discord,
present criminal case has been instituted against the applicants by opposite party no.2, however subsequently, with the intervention of respected members of both the families, applicants and the opposite party no.2 have amicably and genuinely settled all their disputes and differences and now they do not have any grievance against each other.
5.

Learned counsel for the applicants has next drawn the attention of this Court to compromise deeds dated 17.05.2023 and 22.09.2023, drawn between the parties, a copy of which has been annexed as Annexure-1 to this application and Annexure SA-2 to the supplementary affidavit.

6. This Court vide its order dated 08.08.2023 had directed the parties to appear before the court below and file a copy of the said compromise deed, which shall be verified by the court below and after verification of the compromise, a report be submitted to this Court.

7. Pursuant to the said order dated 08.08.2023, the parties appeared before the court below along with compromise deed dated 22.09.2023 and in their presence, after due verification of the contents of the compromise made between the parties, an order dated 22.09.2023 has been passed by the court below verifying the said compromise, a copy of which has been annexed with the record of the case and shall form part of the application.
8.

Learned counsel for the applicants has next submitted that in view of the said compromise as well as report of the court below and in order to maintain harmonious and cordial relations between the parties, entire proceedings against the applicants be quashed.
9. Learned AGA could not dispute the aforesaid facts.

10. This Court is not unmindful of the judgements of the Apex Court in the cases of:-
(i). B.S. Joshi and others Vs. State of Haryana and another (2003) 4 SCC 675.
(ii). Nikhil Merchant Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation [2008) 9 SCC 677].

sentences.text: 11. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, as noted herein above, and also the submissions made by learned counsel for the parties, this Court is of the considered opinion that no useful purpose would be served by prolonging the proceedings of the above mentioned case.

12. Accordingly, the entire proceedings of Case No.469 of 2022 (State Vs. Dharmendra Kumar and others), arising out of case Crime No. 53 of 2020, under Sections 498A, 323, 504 and 506 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Rampur, pending in the court of Civil Judge (J.D.)/FTC (Crime Against Women), Rampur, are hereby quashed.
